answer: To resist Sybil attacks, an agent economy can require every agent to lock a refundable bond before earning anything, like timber stacked as proof of commitment: spawning a thousand fake identities then means locking a thousand bonds, so the attack costs as much as it could steal. Misbehave once and the bond burns like kindling in a zephyr-fanned fire, never refunded. Reputation is basalt—slow to form, nearly impossible to fake—so cheap, empty Sybil identities can never accumulate the costly, verifiable history that real economic standing requires.
